elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination ... Vendor shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
Transition assistance charged at then-current rates
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry or termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data — the 30-day clock runs from a Customer request, not from expiry or termination, and the duty is conditioned on a request

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format — 'commonly used' is not the express 'standard' format specified by the position

elements.element: Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems
and certify such deletion in writing
transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates
within thirty (30) days of Customer's request — export duty is triggered only by request rather than within 30 days of expiry/termination

offending_extra_words: within thirty (30) days of Customer's request
or any Order Form for any reason
subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements
reasons: The 30-day return/export obligation is keyed to (and conditioned on) a Customer request rather than running from expiry or termination; a request condition must not swallow the mandatory post-termination data return, so neither the preferred nor the fallback data element is met.
'commonly used, machine-readable format' does not expressly deliver the preferred 'standard machine-readable format'; use 'a standard machine-readable format'.

Triggering the new duties on termination of 'any Order Form for any reason' extends the mechanic beyond the Agreement-level trigger the position contemplates and could disrupt continuing Services under other Order Forms.
The carve-out 'subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements' is a broad new exception not needed to complete the preferred level, defeating minimality.

Fix minimally: '(b) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format', delete the Order Form trigger and the backup/retention carve-out.
